feedUrls.title: Feed URLs
feedUrls.description: The RSS or Atom feeds to watch, one URL per line. https:// is added when you leave it out. Each feed read is one charged event.

maxSources.title: Max feeds per run
maxSources.description: How many feeds from the list are read in this run. Feeds beyond this number are left for the next run.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
requestDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait between two feed requests. Keep it at 1 or more to stay polite with the servers you read.

requestTimeoutSeconds.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for a feed to answer before it is reported as failed in the run report.
